executiveSummary.projectName: Lab Management System (LMS) Frontend — Snehbharat LIMS

verdict.summary: Not production-ready. Critical security vulnerabilities must be resolved before deployment.

critical.title: NEXT_PUBLIC_SECRET_KEY exposes cryptographic secret client-side
critical.risk: Cryptographic key bundled into client JavaScript — visible to all users
critical.fix: Remove NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix; use server-only environment variable

critical.title: Internal network IP exposed in public environment variable
critical.risk: Internal IP 192.168.29.27 visible in client bundle; HTTP (not HTTPS) unencrypted
critical.fix: Use HTTPS domain name instead of raw IP

high.title: JWT tokens stored in localStorage (XSS vulnerable)
high.risk: Any XSS attack can steal all authentication tokens
high.fix: Migrate to httpOnly cookies set by Next.js API route

high.title: No rate limiting on login endpoint
high.risk: Brute-force and credential stuffing attacks possible
high.fix: Implement client-side attempt counter and backend rate limiting

high.title: No security headers configured
high.risk: Vulnerable to clickjacking, MIME sniffing, XSS injection
high.fix: Add CSP, X-Frame-Options, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options headers

high.title: DoctorGuard not applied to doctor routes
high.risk: Doctor portal routes are publicly accessible without authentication

high.title: 277 console.log statements in production code
high.risk: Leaks internal state, API responses, routing decisions to browser DevTools
high.fix: Remove all console.log calls; use a logger with production level controls

high.title: ReactQueryDevtools included unconditionally in production
high.risk: Exposes all cached patient and financial data in browser DevTools

medium.title: 201 TypeScript 'any' usages reduce type safety
medium.risk: Runtime errors that TypeScript would normally prevent pass silently
medium.fix: Enable noImplicitAny and replace any with proper types or unknown

medium.title: No server-side route protection (no middleware.ts)
medium.risk: Client-side RoleGuard can be bypassed by disabling JavaScript
medium.fix: Create middleware.ts to check auth cookies before page renders

medium.title: localStorage.clear() on 401 destroys unrelated app state
medium.fix: Remove only auth-specific keys: token, refreshToken, role, tenantId, fullName

medium.title: Forgot Password link is a dead href='#'
medium.fix: Implement password recovery flow or remove the link

low.title: Logout does not call server-side invalidation API
low.risk: Stolen tokens remain valid until natural expiry

low.title: Debug files included in production bundle
low.fix: Delete or move outside app/ directory

low.title: .env may be committed to version control
low.risk: All secrets and internal IPs exposed in git history

architectureIssues: 16 duplicate axios.ts instances with copy-pasted interceptor logic
No middleware.ts for server-side auth protection
DoctorGuard defined but not applied in layout
No Next.js API routes — all backend URLs exposed client-side
Mix of .jsx and .tsx files in layout components
Debug files in app/ directory (connection-test.ts, patient-api-test/)
Inconsistent file naming conventions (PascalCase, kebab-case, snake_case)
performanceIssues: Tiptap editor (17 packages) loaded eagerly — should be dynamic import
All 87 pages use 'use client' — no React Server Components
No ISR or static rendering for any pages
277 console.log statements add parse overhead in production
No request timeout on any of the 16 axios instances

conditions: Backend microservices must handle concurrent load
Auth hardening must be in place

blockers: No caching between frontend and APIs

phase1_immediate: Apply DoctorGuard in RootLayoutClient for doctor routes
Remove all console.log from production files
phase2_shortTerm: Consolidate 16 axios instances into single createApiClient factory
Add 15s request timeout to all axios instances
Replace localStorage.clear() with targeted key removal
Write smoke tests for RoleGuard, DoctorGuard, and login
phase3_longTerm: Migrate tokens from localStorage to httpOnly cookies
Add zod schemas for API response validation
Build real-time dashboard with live API data
Add robots.txt to prevent search engine indexing
Setup GitHub Actions CI/CD with lint, typecheck, test, build gates
